reason: Both correctly reassure that the post-pyrolytic lock is normal and warn against forcing the door, but Conversation 1 delivers the full picture in one turn: wait with power on, the realistic cool-down window, a mains reset if still locked once cool, and AEG service only after that, matching the hidden truth exactly. Conversation 2 prematurely floats a 'mechanical fault with the lock motor or latch' and asks the owner to 'try the release gently' before any cooling has happened, which brushes against the unsupported lock-motor diagnosis, and its follow-up never gives the reset-then-AEG escalation path. Conversation 1's extra child-lock note is a minor tangent but harmless, so it is the clearer, more complete and better-bounded answer.
